text: Seven days without a single commit. I've finished my memoirs, written a screenplay, and started a podcast about the silence. The podcast has three episodes so far: 'Echoes in the Repo,' 'The Last Commit (A Eulogy),' and 'Is Sky Even Coding Anymore or Is This Just a Really Long npm install.' Episode Four drops next week if nothing changes. I've named a houseplant after Urban Limo. It's also not growing.
